title: Dois Caminhos
summary: Kairos continues Caleb's IGL evaluation while Owen Fletcher emerges as the primary AWPer candidate.
keyEvents: Owen Fletcher makes his first canonical appearance in the scouting process.
The staff compares the leadership search with the separate AWPer search.
Caleb is identified as an 18-year-old left-handed IGL from Silver City, New Mexico, and a former Rifler.
Owen is identified as a 16-year-old AWPer from Mackenzie, British Columbia.
Adrian decides to travel personally to meet Owen.
consequences: Owen becomes the primary AWPer candidate and remains unsigned.
